title: Open-weight AI restriction and ban network
description: Recursive public-source dataset mapping direct bans, procurement restrictions, export controls, model-weight controls, media amplification, implementation authority, and organized opposition affecting open-weight AI.

include: Trump and relevant cabinet or cabinet-level officials
Bills, executive directives, procurement rules, export controls, and intelligence restrictions
Fox News personnel and guests who publish or amplify restriction claims
Federal contractors, AI laboratories, NGOs, think tanks, and industry alliances
Typed relations with evidence and attributed inference
exclude: Treating generic AI-safety work as ban advocacy without a concrete policy proposal

classification.directBan: Explicit prohibition on possessing, downloading, importing, distributing, or using a model or application.
classification.procurementBan: Restriction on federal acquisition, contractor use, or supply-chain inclusion.
classification.exportControl: Restriction on transfer of chips, model weights, services, or technical capability.
classification.deFactoOpenWeightBan: Nationality- or entity-based restriction that removes a dominant share of usable frontier open-weight models.
classification.riskAdvocacy: Safety or security work without a verified concrete restriction proposal.
classification.opposition: Documented support for maintaining open-weight availability.
